steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.qualityName='high'; g.state.settings.quality='high'; document.exitPointerLock(); return 'quality '+g.qualityName+', readout hidden '+document.getElementById('hud-fps').hidden})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; return 'show frame rate setting '+g.state.settings.showFps+', automatic setting '+g.state.settings.autoQuality})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close?.(); g.paused=false; g.menuOpen=false; return 'menus closed: open '+g.screens.isOpen})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.adapt={avg:0.05,t:0,good:0,slow:0}; const was=g.qualityName; let toast=''; const orig=g.hud.toast.bind(g.hud); g.hud.toast=(m,...r)=>{toast=m; return orig(m,...r)}; for(let i=0;i<400 && g.qualityName===was;i++){ g.adaptResolution(0.05); } g.hud.toast=orig; return 'slow frames at lowest resolution: '+was+' -> '+g.qualityName+', saved setting '+g.state.settings.quality+', toast: '+toast})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.adapt={avg:0.05,t:0,good:0,slow:0}; const was=g.qualityName; for(let i=0;i<400;i++) g.adaptResolution(0.05); return 'with the switch off: '+was+' -> '+g.qualityName})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=true; g.setQuality('medium'); g.qualityName='medium'; g.adapt={avg:0.01,t:0,good:0,slow:0}; g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++) g.adaptResolution(0.01); return 'fast frames: resolution back up to '+g.dpr.toFixed(2)+' (device pixel ratio '+(window.devicePixelRatio||1)+', preset limit '+g.quality.dpr+'), preset '+g.qualityName})()
